jobs.title: Senior Consultant - IT Strategy & Operating Model
jobs.description:
Sia sta ricercando un Senior Consultant per la sede di Milano  (modalità hybrid ) da inserire all'interno della practice CIO Advisory in progetti di definizione di IT Strategy, Target Operating Model, revisione dei processi IT e governance di programmi complessi di trasformazione.
Il candidato prescelto sarà coinvolto - a seconda dell'esperienza maturata - in progetti relativi alle seguenti aree di competenza:
- IT Strategy e roadmap di trasformazione: definizione della strategia IT allineata al business, prioritizzazione delle iniziative, business case e governance dei portfolio di programmi complessi
- IT Target Operating Model, incluso GenAI / AI TOM: disegno del modello operativo IT del futuro e integrazione dell'AI
- IT Processes: Demand, Project e Portfolio Management, IT Service Management, come leve strategiche
- IT Organizational Model: ruoli e responsabilità, dimensionamento, sourcing e make-or-buy
- IT Governance: applicazione dei principali framework (ITIL, COBIT, ...) a supporto delle decisioni e del monitoraggio
- Conoscenza dei principali framework di IT Governance (ITIL, COBIT,...)
- Disegno di modelli di performance management

Avrà inoltre l’opportunità di contribuire attivamente alla crescita e allo sviluppo della Practice (workshops, pubblicazioni, analisi di mercato, partecipazione ai seminari).
Titolo di studio : Laurea Magistrale in Tecnologia e Sistemi, Economia, Ingegneria.
Esperienza professionale : il candidato possiede  almeno 4 anni di esperienza in primarie società di consulenza o all'interno di strutture progettuali IT in aziende multinazionali.
Soft skills :
- Entusiasmo e proattività
- Capacità di analisi e sintesi
- Attitudine al lavoro di gruppo
- Forte orientamento al problem solving
- Passione per il mondo tech
- Eccellenti capacità comunicative, di gestione del cliente e di negoziazione

Conoscenza delle lingue : conoscenza ed utilizzo professionale della lingua inglese; la conoscenza del francese rappresenta un plus.
Lavorando in Sia troverai:
- Un percorso di carriera dinamico e meritocratico, basato sulle performance
- Un ambiente di lavoro realmente internazionale, dove collaborerai con i data hub degli altri uffici dislocati su scala globale all’interno di Team multidisciplinari
- Una continua crescita e un forte spirito imprenditoriale
- Un rapporto diretto con il top management interno e dei nostri clienti
- Un luogo che abbraccia la concezione di lavoro flessibile e fa propri valori come la fiducia, l’autonomia e il rispetto tra le persone
- Un ambiente dove la diversità e l'inclusività sono il fulcro di ciò che siamo e di come lavoriamo

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: In App Marketing Program Manager
jobs.description:
Location:   Bay Area, LA or NYC (Hybrid - 3 days onsite)
About the role
Sia is partnering with a leading technology company to run a high-volume in-app editorial and marketing program across consumer apps and multiple in-app surfaces. We need a program manager with direct experience coordinating content or marketing delivery within consumer apps, from intake and creative development through platform setup, quality checks, and launch.
You will build the tracking systems, run the operating cadence, and keep many concurrent deliverables moving across creative, product marketing, brand, product, and engineering teams. Success requires exceptional organization, hands-on follow-through, and a clear understanding of how content reaches users inside an app. You will also use AI and automation to make program operations more efficient as volume grows.
What you will do
- Own the delivery process for in-app editorial content and marketing placements across multiple app surfaces, coordinating priorities, dependencies, approvals, and launch dates.

- Build and maintain a reliable source of truth for intake, editorial calendars, asset versions, owners, reviews, trafficking status, and launches across a high volume of concurrent work.

- Translate requests into actionable briefs, deliverables, timelines, and responsibilities; identify missing inputs and resolve ambiguity before it slows execution.

- Coordinate creative development and trafficking from asset handoff through content delivery system setup, QA, approval, and go-live; verify that approved assets reach the correct placement on schedule.

- Run status meetings, deadline tracking, and targeted follow-ups that keep creative, agency, product marketing, brand, product, and engineering partners accountable.

- Anticipate dependencies and launch risks, escalate decisions with clear options, and communicate changes in scope, timing, or readiness to the right stakeholders.

- Step in to move work forward when needed, including clarifying briefs, consolidating feedback, updating trackers, checking assets, and coordinating missing approvals.

- Adapt communication to each partner’s needs and turn working sessions into clear decisions, owners, and next steps.

- Identify recurring bottlenecks and improve the process through templates, clearer handoffs, and automation.

- Use AI to improve operational workflows such as intake triage, tracker updates, status reporting, and meeting follow-ups; validate outputs and retain human review where accuracy or approvals matter.

- Ramp quickly on internal in-app content delivery and campaign management tools, learn their setup and QA requirements, and document repeatable processes for the team.
- 4–8 years of experience in program or project management, marketing operations, content operations, trafficking, or campaign operations, including direct responsibility for programs delivered within consumer apps.

- Demonstrated experience managing in-app content, editorial, or marketing delivery across multiple placements or surfaces. Experience must include delivery inside the app, beyond campaigns that promote an app externally.

- A track record of organizing and shipping a high volume of concurrent work, with clear ownership of tracking systems, delivery cadence, and deadline management.

- Hands-on familiarity with content delivery or campaign management systems and workflows covering asset handoff, setup, QA, approvals, and publishing. Trafficking or ad operations experience is strongly preferred.

- Exceptional attention to detail and follow-through, including catching incorrect assets, missing approvals, placement errors, and dependencies before launch.

- Experience keeping cross-functional partners on deadline without direct authority, with the judgment to escalate blockers and the willingness to help resolve them.

- Clear, concise communication across creative, product marketing, brand, product, and engineering teams.

- Ability to learn unfamiliar internal tools quickly and work comfortably with technical partners.

- Hands-on experience using generative AI to improve operational workflows, with a practical approach to checking accuracy and managing exceptions.

- Experience with tools such as Asana, Airtable, Smartsheet, or Jira; ability to design a tracking system around the work rather than rely on a particular tool.
Compensation & Benefits
Sia invests in total rewards that support how our people work, live, and grow.
Compensation
- Base Salary: $130,000-135,000 Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by applicable law.

- Annual Performance Bonus

Benefits
- Medical, dental, and vision; company-paid life and AD&D; voluntary supplemental insurance and EAP

- 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting; HSA and FSA options

- College savings and student loan repayment programs

- Paid parental leave; generous PTO, nine company holidays, and one floating holiday

- Cell phone stipend; well-being and professional development programs

Benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.
Workplace

Sia values in-person collaboration. When serving clients, consultants may be required to work onsite at a client location based on engagement needs. Between client engagements, consultants are expected to work from a Sia office or approved coworking location at least three days per week. Candidates should reside within a reasonable commuting distance of a Sia office or approved coworking location. Sia maintains offices and coworking arrangements across multiple U.S. markets, including New York City, Charlotte, Greater Seattle, San Francisco Greater Bay Area, Los Angeles, Houston, Atlanta, Baltimore, Chicago, Washington D.C.
Work Authorization
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout their employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.
Our Commitment
At Sia, we believe in fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture where our employees and partners are valued and thrive in a sense of belonging.

jobs.description:

Notre mission : les guider dans l'élaboration de leur stratégie digitale et IA ainsi que dans la transformation de leurs offres, de leurs métiers et de leurs pratiques.
Description du poste
Valeur des actifs, nouveaux usages, transformation des métiers, essor de l'IA : l'immobilier connaît une mutation profonde. Chez Sia, nous accompagnons nos clients pour aborder ces évolutions et les transformer en leviers de valeur.
Au sein de notre équipe, vous interviendrez à la croisée de l'immobilier, du digital et du Smart Building pour accompagner nos clients dans trois enjeux majeurs : exploiter le potentiel de la donnée bâtimentaire et patrimoniale, répondre aux exigences croissantes de la transition énergétique et climatique, et piloter la performance financière des actifs.

Vous interviendrez à chaque étape clé des projets : de l'analyse stratégique au cadrage et pilotage, en passant par l'animation d'ateliers et la conduite du changement.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Senior Consultant- Project Manager / Business Analyst
jobs.description:
We're looking for a to join our growing Energy, Utilities & Transportation practice. This is a hybrid PM/BA role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves easily between business and technical teams, and knows how to turn strategy into execution.
You'll lead project delivery, drive process optimization, and support digital, data, and AI transformation work for clients modernizing how they operate. If you're detail-oriented, comfortable in front of executives, and energized by solving messy problems, this role is built for you.
What You'll Do
Project Management
- Own end-to-end delivery: scope, schedule, budget, risks, and governance

- Build and maintain project plans, RAID logs, roadmaps, and executive status reports

- Align stakeholders across business, IT, vendors, and sponsors

- Run workshops, steering committees, and sprint ceremonies

- Spot risks early and drive them to resolution

Business Analysis & Process Optimization
- Gather and document business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria

- Map current and future-state processes and operating models

- Identify opportunities for automation, modernization, and efficiency

- Run gap analyses, root cause analyses, and cost-benefit evaluations

- Support vendor assessments, RFPs, and technology selection

AI, Digital & Technology Transformation
- Partner with stakeholders to identify where AI and automation can move the needle

- Document AI use cases and translate business challenges into tech-enabled solutions

- Evaluate AI platforms, copilots, and automation tools against business needs

- Support adoption: testing, training, change management

- Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and bring new ideas to clients

Technology & Data
- Collaborate with technical teams on implementations, integrations, and testing

- Support reporting, dashboards, data quality, and governance workstreams

- Translate business requirements into technical specs

- Support modernization efforts across cloud, ERP, CRM, EAM, GIS, and other platforms

Consulting & Client Engagement
- Build trusted relationships and act as a strategic advisor throughout delivery

- Lead workshops, requirements sessions, and executive meetings

- Develop client-ready deliverables: business cases, roadmaps, recommendations

- Contribute to proposals, SOWs, and business development

- Mentor junior consultants and help build out practice knowledge

This job description is not intended to be all inclusive. Duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be added, deleted, or modified at any time based on business needs.
Required
- 4+ years in technical project management, business analysis, consulting, or a similar client-facing role

- Track record delivering complex business or technology transformation projects

- Strong PM fundamentals: planning, risk management, stakeholder management, budgeting

- Experience documenting requirements, business process flows, and user stories

- Experience facilitating workshops and managing cross-functional stakeholders

- A track record of spotting opportunities for process improvement or AI-enabled transformation

- Familiarity with generative AI, enterprise AI tools, copilots, or intelligent automation

- Experience working alongside engineering, product, IT, or data teams

- Comfort with process mapping tools (Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, ARIS, or similar)

- Strong analytical chops with Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar

- Excellent communication skills, including with executives

- Ability to juggle multiple priorities in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Mathematics, or related field

Nice to Have
- Consulting background in Energy, Utilities, Transportation, Manufacturing, or other industrial sectors preferred

- Experience running AI transformation from strategy through adoption

- Hands-on experience with AI workflow assessments or intelligent automation

- Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude, Gemini, or similar

- Experience with low-code/no-code platforms like Power Platform, UiPath, or ServiceNow

- Knowledge of Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or hybrid delivery methods

- Experience with ERP, CRM, EAM, GIS, Workday, Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics

- Exposure to Azure, AWS, or GCP

- Experience supporting change management and user adoption

- Certifications like PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, CSPO, CBAP, or Lean Six Sigma
Sia invests in total rewards that support how our people work, live, and grow.
Compensation
- Base Salary: $118,300–$122,400. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by applicable law.

- Annual Performance Bonus

Benefits
- Medical, dental, and vision; company-paid life and AD&D; voluntary supplemental insurance and EAP

- 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting; HSA and FSA options

- College savings and student loan repayment programs

- Paid parental leave; generous PTO, nine company holidays, and one floating holiday

- Cell phone stipend; well-being and professional development programs

Benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.
Workplace

Sia values in-person collaboration. When serving clients, consultants may be required to work onsite at a client location based on engagement needs. Between client engagements, consultants are expected to work from a Sia office or approved coworking location at least three days per week. Candidates should reside within a reasonable commuting distance of a Sia office or approved coworking location. Sia maintains offices and coworking arrangements across multiple U.S. markets, including New York City, Charlotte, Greater Seattle, San Francisco Greater Bay Area, Los Angeles, Houston, Atlanta, Baltimore, Chicago, Washington D.C.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout their employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.

At Sia, we believe in fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture where our employees and partners are valued and thrive in a sense of belonging.

jobs.title: Partner Marketing Manager - Contract
jobs.description:
Contract roles are geared toward independent professionals interested in temporary or project-based work.
Sia Title: Project Consultant (Exempt Contractor)
Project Title:  Partner Marketing Manager
Level: Mid-Senior
Project Length: This is a temporary position with an expected duration (through 12/31/26) possibility to extend into the new year
Project Hours : 40 hours per week $80-85/hour
The expected compensation for this contract is per year. The exact pay rate will vary depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to skills, experience, and location.
Location: (preferred)  NYC/hyrbid or (open to Remote EST hours)
We are seeking a highly motivated Partner Marketing Manager to help drive growth through strategic partner relationships. Provide day-to-day ownership of alliance marketing execution and partner workstreams across strategic partners. This role will focus on building and executing partner marketing programs that generate demand, strengthen partner engagement, and support joint go-to-market initiatives.
Workstyle
You are a high-agency operator that combines speed with professional maturity:
- High-Velocity Adaptability:  You have a "can-do" spirit and the mental agility to pivot as priorities shift. You are a fast learner who masters new concepts and complex workflows with minimal ramp-up time.

- Acute Professional Judgment:  You move fast but with a high level of precision. You take pride in being the final line of defense, ensuring all work is vetted, polished, and strategically sound before it reaches a partner or client.

- Autonomous Problem-Solver:  You thrive in ambiguous environments and take ownership of the "how." You provide finished work-products that simplify the lives of your leaders by anticipating needs and delivering with precision.

Impact
In this role, you will be the engine behind strategic partner marketing initiatives and enterprise technology partner workstreams. Your core focus includes:
- Enterprise Partner Ecosystem Execution: Managing day-to-day marketing workstreams across strategic technology partners and enterprise clients, including AWS, Salesforce, and systems integrators, keeping internal teams and external stakeholders aligned and initiatives moving forward.
- Business Development Enablement & Marketing Fulfillment: Serving as the central hub for co-marketing, equipping BD with the materials and marketing support needed to secure partnerships, then owning delivery of the marketing commitments agreed to after signature.
- Project & Program Management: Owning timelines, deliverables, dependencies, approvals, and follow-ups across complex partner initiatives, proactively resolving blockers and adapting to shifting priorities while maintaining speed and quality.
- Joint GTM & Demand Generation: Applying B2B SaaS and enterprise technology expertise to execute joint campaigns, webinars, nurtures, events, and integrated programs that strengthen partner engagement and contribute to measurable pipeline growth.
- Scalable Partner Programs: Developing reusable templates, playbooks, and workflows that streamline execution and enable partner programs to scale across partners and markets while accommodating individual requirements.
- Strategic Content Creation: Drafting and designing polished partner communications, campaign assets, sales enablement materials, internal updates, executive presentations, and GTM materials tailored to enterprise audiences.
- Co-Marketing Review & Approval: Managing the review process across Marketing, Growth, Direct Response, and Partnerships, ensuring all partner-facing materials are accurate, polished, aligned with joint GTM priorities, and appropriately approved before release.
- Partner Brand Governance: Maintaining a central source of truth for partner commitments, brand guidelines, logo usage permissions and restrictions, and approval requirements across markets, ensuring teams use current information.
- AI Partnership & GTM Execution: Supporting partner marketing for AI products and offerings, coordinating internal teams and partners on joint messaging, marketing deliverables, and GTM execution.
- AI-Forward Operations: Using AI tools to streamline workflows, accelerate content development, improve organization, and scale partner marketing execution while validating outputs for accuracy and quality.
- Operational Inputs & Reporting: Partnering with Operations and Data Science teams to support monthly business reviews, pipeline tracking, and partner performance reporting, using insights to identify improvements and inform future initiatives.

What Success Looks Like
- Reliability & Trust: Leadership and stakeholders view you as a force multiplier because you independently deliver polished, high-quality work that requires minimal oversight or revision.
- Operational Momentum: Partner marketing workstreams are organized, transparent, and consistently moving forward, with stakeholders aligned and deadlines effectively managed.
- Strong Project Leadership: Complex initiatives remain on track because you proactively manage communication, dependencies, timelines, and execution across multiple teams and enterprise stakeholders.
- Executive-Ready Deliverables: Presentations, communications, reports, and campaign materials are strategic, polished, accurate, and tailored appropriately for enterprise audiences.
- AI-Enhanced Execution: You effectively incorporate AI-enabled tools and workflows into your day-to-day execution, improving efficiency, organization, and scalability across partner initiatives.
- Seamless Adaptability: You navigate changing priorities, shifting partner needs, and evolving business goals with agility while maintaining strong execution quality.
- Measurable Business Impact: Your work contributes to stronger partner engagement, improved operational visibility, scalable GTM execution, and measurable pipeline growth.
- 5+ years of experience in partner marketing, alliance marketing, channel marketing, program management, or related B2B marketing functions
- Experience supporting enterprise tech company clients and/or working within enterprise SaaS or technology environments
- Strong project management and program management skills with experience managing multiple complex workstreams simultaneously
- Proven ability to coordinate cross-functional stakeholders and drive initiatives from planning through execution
- Experience supporting strategic partner ecosystems including AWS, Salesforce, SIs, or comparable enterprise alliances
- Strong understanding of B2B demand generation and partner-driven go-to-market strategies
- Experience developing executive presentations, partner communications, campaign assets, and marketing materials
- AI fluency with the ability to leverage AI tools to improve workflows, efficiency, organization, and content development
- Highly proactive, solutions-oriented, and comfortable operating independently in fast-paced environments
- Strong professional judgment with exceptional attention to detail and execution quality
- Strong written and verbal communication skills across internal and external enterprise stakeholders
- Ability to manage shifting priorities while maintaining organization, speed, and high-quality execution
- Experience in Management Consulting collaborating across Marketing, Sales, Operations, Analytics, and Partner teams

jobs.description:
Vous souhaitez accompagner les organisations dans la structuration et la transformation de leurs politiques RH en matière de classification et de rémunération, tout en assurant leur conformité réglementaire notamment en matière de transparence des rémunérations ?

Référentiel des emplois et classification

jobs.title: Vulnerability & Patch Management (Senior) Consultant
jobs.description:
Vulnerability & Patch Management (Senior) Consultant
About the Role  We are seeking an experienced Vulnerability & Patch Management (Senior) Consultant, with experience in owning the end-to-end vulnerability lifecycle: from discovery and prioritization to remediation and verification on cloud environments (primary GCP then AWS).
Key Responsibilities
- Operate and optimize the Vulnerability & Patch platform for vulnerability scanning, asset discovery, and exposure management across the enterprise.

- Lead risk-based prioritization of vulnerabilities using Tenable One's analytics and exposure scoring.
- Design, coordinate, and oversee patch management processes, balancing security needs with the availability requirements of a high-uptime trading environment.
- Track remediation SLAs, report on risk exposure, and drive timely closure with system and application owners.
- Collaborate with infrastructure, DevOps, and cloud teams to embed security into deployment and maintenance workflows.
- Maintain awareness of emerging threats, CVEs, and exploit trends, translating them into actionable remediation plans.
- Support audits and contribute to continuous improvement of security policies and standards.
Required Qualifications
- 1–5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with a strong focus on vulnerability and patch management.
- Hands-on expertise with the Tenable One platform (or strong Tenable.io / Tenable.sc / Nessus experience with willingness to transition).
- Solid understanding of operating systems (Windows/Linux), networking, and common attack vectors.
- Strong analytical, prioritization, and stakeholder-communication skills.
- English & Dutch communication and presentation skills.

Nice to Have
- ISO 27001 knowledge or certification (e.g., Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor).
- Google Cloud Platform certifications (e.g., Professional Cloud Security Engineer) are highly valued.
- Experience in critical infrastructure, energy, or other highly regulated/high-availability sectors.
What do we offer?
- Competitive salary with great extra advantages
- Training plan to develop yourself as an expert in your discipline.
- You have the opportunity to work from home, the client or from our inspiring office in Amsterdam.
- Working in an international environment which creates opportunities to share knowledge and work together on international projects with colleagues all over the world.

Additional information

jobs.title: Associate Consultant - Graduating 2027
jobs.description:
The Position:

The primary role of an Associate Consultant is to support engagements by driving the research and fact-gathering process, analysing and synthesising findings, and developing deliverables for clients. Associate Consultants work across practices as generalists and are staffed on projects that vary in industry, scope, and length, offering exceptional early exposure to diverse consulting engagements.

As an Associate Consultant, you will:
- Have direct and immediate client-facing access

- Hands-on mentoring from, and access to, senior-level leadership

- Distil actionable and meaningful insights from research using relevant quantitative techniques and appropriate analytical frameworks

- Effectively communicate our conclusions directly to clients through impactful, creative presentations

- Be supported by an unparalleled group of peers and leaders throughout each engagement
The Essentials for Success:

The ideal candidate will have demonstrated a high level of academic achievement at the university level. Prior relevant internship or project-based work experience in strategy consulting or market research is highly desirable. You must be naturally curious and self-motivated, able to prioritize effectively, and equipped with strong business acumen and analytical skills. Our Associate Consultants are expected to be comfortable working independently as well as collaboratively, and bring excellent communication skills, confidence, and a 'can-do' attitude.

Required:
- BA or BSc, in 2027 from an accredited university. Targeted majors include Business, Economics, Engineering, Liberal Arts, Mathematics, and Science, though we remain open to other disciplines

- Demonstrated success in gathering primary and secondary research through a range of research methodologies

- Relevant internships are a plus

- Exceptional analytical skills; experience working with large datasets and modelling

- Initiative-taking: exhibiting flexibility and willingness to take on new responsibilities and assignments and to assist with various ad hoc projects as needed

- Comfort with ambiguity: ability to synthesise implications and triangulate from various data sources

- Well organised: ability to manage multiple projects and priorities efficiently

- Excellent written and verbal communication

- Demonstrated experience exercising critical thinking and problem-solving skills

- Foreign language fluency preferred, but not required

- Strong computer skills (Excel, PowerPoint, MS Word)
Benefits
We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the wellbeing, financial security, and work–life balance of our employees.
- 25 days of annual leave per year, in addition to applicable public holidays

- Life insurance cover

- Health and travel insurance which supports a range of healthcare needs and includes cover when travelling

- Salary Sacrifice - Personal pension scheme operated on a salary sacrifice basis, employer contributions (minimum 4%), matched up to 6%

- Cycle to Work Scheme

Benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.
We embrace a flexible workplace model that balances autonomy with in-person connection. Associate consultants are expected to be in the office at least three days per week.
Applicants must be legally authorised to work in the United Kingdom at the time of application and throughout their employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.
Our Commitment
We believe in fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture where our employees and partners are valued and thrive in a sense of belonging.

jobs.description:

- Accompagnement à la formalisation et mise en place de plans et procédures de gestion de crise, communication de crise, continuité d’activité et continuité informatique

jobs.title: Marketing Program Manager - Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
Location: [SF Bay Area, NYC, or Los Angeles] (Hybrid - 3 days onsite)
About the Role
Sia is seeking a Senior Consultant, Marketing Program Management to join our Marketing Advisory practice. This is a full-time consulting role for someone who combines strong program management, marketing expertise, strategic thinking, and an AI-forward mindset.
You’ll work directly with clients on complex marketing initiatives, helping turn strategy into action and keeping programs moving from planning through execution. Depending on the engagement, you may support a major campaign or product launch, manage a cross-functional marketing workstream, improve existing processes, or help clients identify new ways to use AI and automation.
We’re looking for a versatile marketing generalist who can quickly understand a business challenge, bring structure to ambiguity, and get things done. You should be equally comfortable developing a project plan, facilitating a client meeting, building an executive-ready deck, analyzing performance, or exploring how AI could improve a marketing workflow.
What You'll Do
Drive Marketing Programs
- Own marketing workstreams from planning through execution, launch, and measurement

- Translate client objectives into clear deliverables, timelines, owners, dependencies, and next steps

- Bring structure to ambiguous or evolving initiatives and keep programs moving forward

- Identify risks and roadblocks early and proactively drive solutions

- Use data, performance insights, and stakeholder feedback to inform recommendations and improve future programs

Partner Across Teams
- Coordinate across marketing, creative, product, analytics, media, technology, localization, and other cross-functional teams

- Facilitate client meetings and working sessions, turning discussions into clear decisions and actions

- Develop polished presentations, recommendations, program updates, and other executive-ready deliverables

- Build strong client relationships and communicate effectively with stakeholders at multiple levels

- Identify opportunities to improve processes, workflows, and ways of working

Bring an AI-Forward Mindset
- Identify practical opportunities to apply AI across marketing strategy, operations, content, insights, and execution

- Use AI tools to accelerate research, planning, analysis, content development, and program management

- Look beyond existing processes and consider how AI and automation can create smarter, more scalable ways of working

- Stay curious about emerging AI capabilities and translate them into practical marketing use cases for clients

- Experiment with new tools and approaches and help teams understand where AI can deliver meaningful value
- 4-8 years of experience across marketing program management, integrated marketing, marketing operations, marketing strategy, project management, or related areas

- Strong understanding of marketing fundamentals and how programs move from strategy through execution

- Experience managing cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and dependencies

- Strong project management, prioritization, problem-solving, and organizational skills

- Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to create clear, client-ready materials

- Ability to bring structure and direction to ambiguous situations while adapting as priorities evolve

- Comfort using data and insights to inform marketing decisions

- Genuine curiosity about AI and emerging technology, including how they are changing marketing

- Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution

Nice to Have
- Consulting, agency, or client services experience

- Experience working with large technology or consumer brands

- Hands-on experience incorporating generative AI into marketing workflows

- Experience across digital, growth, product, lifecycle, or integrated marketing

- Familiarity with marketing technology, automation, campaign management, or measurement platforms

What Success Looks Like
You become a trusted member of both the Sia and client teams who can take ownership of a marketing workstream, bring structure to complexity, and consistently move work forward.
You combine strong marketing instincts with excellent execution and an AI-forward mindset, helping clients deliver great work today while finding smarter ways to approach marketing in the future.
Compensation & Benefits
Sia invests in total rewards that support how our people work, live, and grow.
Compensation
- Base Salary: $124,400–$129,500. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by applicable law.

- Annual Performance Bonus

Benefits
- Medical, dental, and vision; company-paid life and AD&D; voluntary supplemental insurance and EAP

- 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting; HSA and FSA options

- College savings and student loan repayment programs

- Paid parental leave; generous PTO, nine company holidays, and one floating holiday

- Cell phone stipend; well-being and professional development programs

Benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.
Workplace

Sia values in-person collaboration. When serving clients, consultants may be required to work onsite at a client location based on engagement needs. Between client engagements, consultants are expected to work from a Sia office or approved coworking location at least three days per week. Candidates should reside within a reasonable commuting distance of a Sia office or approved coworking location. Sia maintains offices and coworking arrangements across multiple U.S. markets, including New York City, Charlotte, Greater Seattle, San Francisco Greater Bay Area, Los Angeles, Houston, Atlanta, Baltimore, Chicago, Washington D.C.
Work Authorization
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout their employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.

jobs.title: Web Program Manager (PM)
jobs.description:
Location: [SF Bay Area, NYC, or Los Angeles] (Hybrid - 3 days onsite)
Impact
This role sits at the intersection of web, marketing, and execution. You’ll act as a hands-on partner to the client, supporting go-to-market launches by translating strategy into high-quality web experiences and deliverables.
Operating within defined scopes to move work forward, you will conduct research, shape web recommendations, and translate marketing and product needs into clear briefs and actionable web workstreams. You’ll ensure that web is effectively positioned within the broader marketing funnel, from acquisition through engagement. You play a critical role in helping the client make informed decisions about how web supports launches, from structure and content to performance and measurement, while keeping work organized, prioritized, and moving.
Key Responsibilities
Web Marketing & Execution
- Translate marketing initiatives into effective web experiences, including landing pages, campaign pages, and other digital experiences
- Develop clear briefs and requirements that translate marketing, product, audience, and brand needs into actionable web work
- Partner across design, content, development, and other stakeholders to move work from brief through execution
- Support decisions around site structure, content types, and user journeys, including landing page strategy, SEO considerations, and content formats
- Ensure web experiences align with broader campaign and product launch goals

Go-to-Market Support
- Support product and campaign launches through targeted tasks, including research, audits, recommendations, planning, and execution
- Conduct analysis on customer journeys, the competitive landscape, and SEO opportunities
- Understand how audience, product, brand, and campaign priorities come together across the web experience
- Contribute to shaping how web fits into the full marketing funnel

Project Management & Prioritization
- Manage day-to-day workflow, balancing multiple incoming requests with varying levels of urgency
- Triage and prioritize work effectively, making informed tradeoffs when needed
- Maintain organization across tasks, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables
- Communicate progress clearly and proactively
- Translate ambiguous requests into clear requirements, next steps, and executable workstreams

Analytics & Optimization
- Use data to validate decisions and inform recommendations
- Analyze site performance metrics, including engagement, conversion, and traffic behavior
- Contribute to reporting and dashboards to track performance and impact

Stakeholder Collaboration
- Partner closely with the client, maintaining strong alignment and communication
- Check in proactively on direction and approach rather than working in isolation
- Translate between teams with different priorities, inputs, and areas of expertise
- Navigate different personalities and working styles with strong emotional intelligence
- Read the room and adapt communication and execution style accordingly
- Provide cross-functional partners with the context and direction needed to move work forward effectively

- You can take an ambiguous initiative and turn it into a clear brief, plan, and executable web workstream
- Cross-functional partners have the context and direction they need to move work forward
- Requests are properly prioritized, with urgency and impact balanced effectively
- You take initiative while staying aligned, proactively checking direction and avoiding missteps
- The client trusts your judgment and sees you as a reliable, thoughtful partner
- Web recommendations are grounded in both marketing strategy and performance data
- You operate independently within your scope without needing excessive direction
- Work is organized, timelines are managed, and nothing falls through the cracks
- You contribute to smarter decisions around site experience, structure, and measurement

This job description is not intended to be all inclusive. Duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be added, deleted, or modified at any time based on business needs.

- 4–7 years of experience in web marketing, digital marketing, or closely related roles, such as web strategy, web marketing management, digital experience, or marketing operations ideally in a management consulting setting
- Experience developing briefs, requirements, and project plans for web initiatives
- Experience supporting marketing or product launches and contributing to web strategy and execution, without necessarily owning full programs end-to-end
- Strong understanding of how web fits into the full marketing funnel, including acquisition, engagement, and conversion, with knowledge of: - Landing page strategy
- SEO fundamentals
- Content structure and user journeys

- Experience using data to inform decisions, including familiarity with web analytics, dashboards, and performance metrics such as traffic, engagement, and conversion behavior
- Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize multiple workstreams, especially in environments with shifting or ambiguous priorities
- Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, product, creative, design, development, or related teams
- Ability to translate inputs from multiple stakeholders into clear, actionable web requirements and workstreams
- Ability to operate with autonomy within a defined scope while proactively aligning with stakeholders
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred
- Familiarity with SEO basics and how they integrate into web content workflows
- Consumer hardware, e-commerce, or devices web marketing background
- Experience with project management tools
- Content strategy experience, including educational guides, product exploration, or editorial calendars
- Agency coordination experience

jobs.title: Web Program Manager (PM)
jobs.description:
Location: [SF Bay Area, NYC, or Los Angeles] (Hybrid - 3 days onsite)
Impact
This role sits at the intersection of web, marketing, and execution. You’ll act as a hands-on partner to the client, supporting go-to-market launches by translating strategy into high-quality web experiences and deliverables.
Operating within defined scopes to move work forward, you will conduct research, shape web recommendations, and translate marketing and product needs into clear briefs and actionable web workstreams. You’ll ensure that web is effectively positioned within the broader marketing funnel, from acquisition through engagement. You play a critical role in helping the client make informed decisions about how web supports launches, from structure and content to performance and measurement, while keeping work organized, prioritized, and moving.
Key Responsibilities
Web Marketing & Execution
- Translate marketing initiatives into effective web experiences, including landing pages, campaign pages, and other digital experiences
- Develop clear briefs and requirements that translate marketing, product, audience, and brand needs into actionable web work
- Partner across design, content, development, and other stakeholders to move work from brief through execution
- Support decisions around site structure, content types, and user journeys, including landing page strategy, SEO considerations, and content formats
- Ensure web experiences align with broader campaign and product launch goals

Go-to-Market Support
- Support product and campaign launches through targeted tasks, including research, audits, recommendations, planning, and execution
- Conduct analysis on customer journeys, the competitive landscape, and SEO opportunities
- Understand how audience, product, brand, and campaign priorities come together across the web experience
- Contribute to shaping how web fits into the full marketing funnel

Project Management & Prioritization
- Manage day-to-day workflow, balancing multiple incoming requests with varying levels of urgency
- Triage and prioritize work effectively, making informed tradeoffs when needed
- Maintain organization across tasks, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables
- Communicate progress clearly and proactively
- Translate ambiguous requests into clear requirements, next steps, and executable workstreams

Analytics & Optimization
- Use data to validate decisions and inform recommendations
- Analyze site performance metrics, including engagement, conversion, and traffic behavior
- Contribute to reporting and dashboards to track performance and impact

Stakeholder Collaboration
- Partner closely with the client, maintaining strong alignment and communication
- Check in proactively on direction and approach rather than working in isolation
- Translate between teams with different priorities, inputs, and areas of expertise
- Navigate different personalities and working styles with strong emotional intelligence
- Read the room and adapt communication and execution style accordingly
- Provide cross-functional partners with the context and direction needed to move work forward effectively

What Success Looks Like
- Web work is delivered accurately, efficiently, and with strong attention to detail
- You demonstrate a clear understanding of how web supports marketing and product launches
- You can take an ambiguous initiative and turn it into a clear brief, plan, and executable web workstream
- Cross-functional partners have the context and direction they need to move work forward
- Requests are properly prioritized, with urgency and impact balanced effectively
- You take initiative while staying aligned, proactively checking direction and avoiding missteps
- The client trusts your judgment and sees you as a reliable, thoughtful partner
- Web recommendations are grounded in both marketing strategy and performance data
- You operate independently within your scope without needing excessive direction
- Work is organized, timelines are managed, and nothing falls through the cracks
- You contribute to smarter decisions around site experience, structure, and measurement

This job description is not intended to be all inclusive. Duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be added, deleted, or modified at any time based on business needs.
Required
- 4–7 years of experience in web marketing, digital marketing, or closely related roles, such as web strategy, web marketing management, digital experience, or marketing operations ideally in a management consulting setting
- Experience developing briefs, requirements, and project plans for web initiatives
- Experience supporting marketing or product launches and contributing to web strategy and execution, without necessarily owning full programs end-to-end
- Strong understanding of how web fits into the full marketing funnel, including acquisition, engagement, and conversion, with knowledge of: - Landing page strategy
- SEO fundamentals
- Content structure and user journeys

- Experience using data to inform decisions, including familiarity with web analytics, dashboards, and performance metrics such as traffic, engagement, and conversion behavior
- Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize multiple workstreams, especially in environments with shifting or ambiguous priorities
- Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, product, creative, design, development, or related teams
- Ability to translate inputs from multiple stakeholders into clear, actionable web requirements and workstreams
- Ability to operate with autonomy within a defined scope while proactively aligning with stakeholders
- Bachelor's degree

- Familiarity with SEO basics and how they integrate into web content workflows
- Consumer hardware, e-commerce, or devices web marketing background
- Experience with project management tools
- Content strategy experience, including educational guides, product exploration, or editorial calendars
- Agency coordination experience

Sia invests in total rewards that support how our people work, live, and grow.

jobs.description:
En tant que Manager CIO Advisory , vous rejoignez l’équipe  Technology Advantage  de Sia.
Au sein de cette Business Unit, nos équipes interviennent auprès de l’ensemble des secteurs d’activités (transport, énergie, banque & assurance, secteur public…) sur les principaux leviers de la transformation numérique. Leurs missions :
- Éclairer nos clients sur l’IT, l’IA et la Data face à l’évolution rapide de technologies émergentes pour les aider à définir un cap stratégique adapté à leurs besoins

Dans ce contexte, vous intervenez au sein d’équipes pluridisciplinaires sur des missions Data et IA variées, en cadrage et en accompagnement sur des projets d’ampleur sur des problématiques telles que :
Organisation, Operating Model, Leadership : transformation des organisations et de leur modèle opérationnel (mode produit, IA centric, IA natif), gestion des compétences (SBO, SWP IT), leadership et culture

- Définition de la stratégie SI et de la feuille de route, de la trajectoire technologique d’un SI IA driven
- Cadrage et pilotage de programmes / projets, accompagnement au déploiement
- Diligence IT afin d’évaluer un potentiel achat / carve-out / investissement (faisabilité, risques, transformations à réaliser…)

Performance opérationnelle :
- Définition / optimisation de l’expérience client, des processus métiers et des parcours utilisateurs
- Excellence opérationnelle (Lean Management, AI for Dev, AI for Ops, DevSecOps)
- Audit/Diagnostic et recommandations (organisation, processus, gouvernance, cartographie des risques…)

Architecture et innovation technologique : organisation de la fonction architecture, cadre normatif architecture, choix d’architecture, évaluation technologique.
Transformation cloud et plateformes : définition de stratégie cloud et IA, mise en place de centre d’excellence, FInOps et GreenOps, modernisation du SI.
Optimisation des opérations & ITSM : stratégie de performance de la fonction, fiabilisation des opérations, définition et optimisation de processus ITSM, Observabilité, structuration et déploiement de l’AI for Ops
Performance économique : Business Cases, Benchmarks, optimisation financière, rentabilité Cloud et IA

- La politique de publication (articles, études, parutions presse...).
- Le développement de l’activité : animation de plans de compte, pilotage de relation client, farming, cross-selling, etc.
- Le pilotage de réponses aux appels d’offres et de propositions commerciales.
- L’Intervention lors de nos événements clients : petits-déjeuners, formations, retour d’expérience.
Diplômé(e) d’une grande école d’ingénieur, de commerce, ou d’une université de premier plan, vous justifiez d’au moins 5 années d’expérience dans le conseil ou auprès de Directions Data, IA ou SI sur des enjeux de CIO Advisory ou de transformation digitale.
Vous avez développé une expertise sur une ou plusieurs des problématiques listées ci-dessus. Vous avez une première expérience de l’encadrement d’équipe.

Vous disposez d'une appétence pour les enjeux liés à la data et l'IA, d'une capacité à monter en compétences rapidement sur ces sujets et êtes enthousiaste à l'idée d'accompagner nos clients à en saisir les opportunités.

jobs.title: AI Transformation Manager
jobs.description:
We're looking for an AI Transformation Manager to join Sia's ETI practice and help clients across energy, transportation, and industrial sectors successfully adopt and scale AI across their organizations.
This is a business- and strategy-facing role. You'll work with executives and operational leaders to identify where AI can create value, build the roadmap to get there, and lead clients through the change required to make adoption stick. You are not expected to write production code or build models yourself. Your value is knowing what today's AI tools and platforms can realistically do, translating that into a business case, and leading the organizational change that turns a pilot into an operating reality.
You'll join a growing ETI team, working day to day alongside Applied AI Leads and other Sia consultants who own the technical build, so you can focus on where you add the most value: strategy, stakeholder alignment, and delivery leadership.
What You'll Do
Lead AI Transformation Strategy
- Partner with executive and operational stakeholders to identify where AI can improve efficiency, productivity, decision-making, and customer outcomes

- Assess current business processes and operating models to identify high-impact AI use cases

- Develop AI transformation roadmaps aligned to business objectives and measurable outcomes

- Lead client workshops focused on AI strategy, prioritization, and adoption

Drive Delivery & Change Management
- Lead end-to-end delivery of AI-enabled transformation initiatives, partnering with Applied AI Leads and technical teams to translate strategy into execution

- Manage multiple workstreams while balancing scope, timelines, risks, and stakeholder expectations

- Establish governance, KPIs, and reporting to measure business impact and adoption

- Build trusted relationships with business and technology leaders

- Drive organizational adoption through communication, training, and change management

- Present recommendations and progress updates to executive stakeholders

- Mentor junior consultants and contribute to ETI practice development

Evaluate & Guide AI Tool Adoption
- Maintain working knowledge of Generative AI, AI agents, copilots, and automation platforms so you can evaluate options and advise clients, without needing to build or configure them yourself

- Assess vendor and platform options and recommend practical enterprise applications

- Support organizations in moving from pilot to production by aligning stakeholders, timelines, and change readiness, working closely with the technical build team

Business Process Improvement
- Analyze existing workflows and identify opportunities for automation and operational improvement

- Lead process redesign initiatives leveraging AI and digital technologies

- Build repeatable frameworks, playbooks, and documentation that enable sustainable transformation
Required
- 6-10+ years of experience in management consulting, business transformation, technology consulting, operations, or digital transformation

- Experience leading complex cross-functional programs from strategy through implementation

- Experience identifying business process improvement opportunities and driving organizational change

- Working knowledge of Generative AI, AI agents, copilots, workflow automation, or intelligent automation platforms as a practitioner and evaluator (not required to build or code)

- Experience partnering with both business and technical stakeholders

- Strong executive communication and presentation skills

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client engagements in fast-paced consulting environments

- Bachelor's degree required

Preferred
- Experience serving clients in Energy & Utilities, Transportation & Logistics, Manufacturing, or Industrial Products

- Experience with AI platforms such as OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Gemini, AWS Bedrock, or Azure AI, as a user and evaluator

- Experience with Agile delivery methodologies

- PMP, Scrum Master, Lean Six Sigma, or other project management certification

- Familiarity with data visualization and project tracking tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Smartsheet, Azure DevOps, or ServiceNow
Sia invests in total rewards that support how our people work, live, and grow.
Compensation
- Annual Base Salary Ranges, commensurate with experience and qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by applicable law.  - Associate Manager Level: $142,800 - $147,900
- Manager Level: $150,000 - $160,000

- Annual Performance Bonus

Benefits
- Medical, dental, and vision; company-paid life and AD&D; voluntary supplemental insurance and EAP

- 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting; HSA and FSA options

- College savings and student loan repayment programs

- Paid parental leave; generous PTO, nine company holidays, and one floating holiday

- Cell phone stipend; well-being and professional development programs

Benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.
Workplace

Sia values in-person collaboration. When serving clients, consultants may be required to work onsite at a client location based on engagement needs. Between client engagements, consultants are expected to work from a Sia office or approved coworking location at least three days per week. Candidates should reside within a reasonable commuting distance of a Sia office or approved coworking location. Sia maintains offices and coworking arrangements across multiple U.S. markets, including New York City, Charlotte, Greater Seattle, San Francisco Greater Bay Area, Los Angeles, Houston, Atlanta, Baltimore, Chicago, Washington D.C.
Work Authorization
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout their employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.
Our Commitment

Intervenez dans le cadre de projets RH et organisationnels d’ampleur, au sein de la Business Unit Human Resources & Transformation , spécialisée dans la transformation des directions RH, auprès de clients dans des secteurs d’activités variés (banque, énergie, transport, secteur public, retail, etc).
En tant que consultant(e) confirmé(e) , vous intervenez directement auprès de nos clients (CAC 40, SBF 120, ETI / PME) sur les thématiques suivantes :

Quelques exemples de projets réalisés récemment :

- Accompagnement humain des transformations : analyser les niveaux de rupture pour définir et mettre en œuvre une stratégie de change (formation, communication, animation de communautés)
- Learning & Development : élaborer une stratégie de formation de bout en bout, œuvrer à une culture d’entreprise favorisant l’apprentissage, concevoir et piloter de grands programmes de formation, animer des formations auprès des apprenants en tant qu’organisme de formation agréé.

- Déploiement de la Talent Marketplace d’un leader de la distribution, dans un objectif de Skills Based Organization
- Déploiement du nouveau système d’évaluation des postes à l’échelle mondiale (130 pays) pour un leader multi-énergies

jobs.title: Program Manager, Business Transformation & Enterprise Systems Implementation (Oracle Utilities)
jobs.description:
Role Overview
​ We are seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager to lead a large-scale business transformation and process improvement initiative focused on the implementation of Oracle Utilities Customer Cloud Service (CCS), Oracle Utilities Work and Asset Cloud Service (WACS), and related utility business systems. This strategic leadership role will oversee the planning, execution, governance, and successful delivery of a multi-year transformation program impacting customer service, billing, work management, field operations, finance, and regulatory processes.
The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in business process transformation with experience leading complex ERP/enterprise application implementations within Natural Gas, Electric, Water, or other regulated industries. They must be equally comfortable engaging with executive leadership, business stakeholders, and technical teams to ensure delivery of both technology and business value.
Key Responsibilities
Program Leadership & Governance
- Lead a large-scale enterprise transformation program involving Oracle CCS, WACS, and associated utility operational systems.
- Establish and maintain program governance, steering committees, executive reporting, risk management, issue resolution, and decision-making processes.
- Develop and manage integrated program plans, budgets, resource allocations, dependencies, milestones, and critical path activities.
- Ensure alignment between business objectives, regulatory requirements, and technology implementation strategies.
- Drive accountability across cross-functional teams, vendors, system integrators, and business stakeholders.
- Manage multi-functional roles across business and technical workstreams.

Business Transformation & Process Improvement
- Strong business acumen and experience in utility transformation.
- Lead end-to-end business process redesign efforts to improve operational efficiency, customer experience, service delivery, billing accuracy, and regulatory compliance.
- Facilitate workshops to assess current-state processes and define future-state operating models.
- Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, optimization, and process simplification.
- Develop business cases, value realization frameworks, and KPI measurement programs.
- Ensure organizational readiness through change management, communications, and stakeholder engagement activities.

Systems Implementation Leadership
- In conjunction with IT PMO, oversee implementation and integration of Oracle CCS/CC&B, WACS, and related enterprise applications.
- Coordinate business requirements gathering, solution design, testing, data conversion, training, cutover planning, and production deployment.
- Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Data, and Application teams to ensure successful delivery.
- Manage system integrators, software vendors, and consulting partners to achieve contractual and project objectives.
- Ensure adoption of industry best practices for utility customer service, billing, work management, and operational processes.

Stakeholder Management
- Serve as the primary liaison between executive leadership, business units, IT leadership, regulators, and external partners.
- Present program status, risks, financial performance, and key decisions to executive steering committees.
- Build strong relationships with customer service, operations, finance, regulatory, field services, and technology organizations.
- Drive enterprise-wide alignment and consensus among diverse stakeholder groups.

Risk & Financial Management
- Manage program budgets that may exceed several million dollars.
- Develop and maintain risk mitigation plans, issue logs, and contingency strategies.
- Monitor program financial performance and ensure delivery within approved budget parameters.
- Track benefits realization and business outcomes throughout the program lifecycle.
Education
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Project Management, or related discipline.
- Master's Degree preferred (MBA, MIS or similar).

Experience
- 10+ years of progressive experience leading large-scale business and technology transformation initiatives.
- 5+ years of program management experience delivering complex ERP, CIS, CRM, billing, or enterprise system implementations.
- Demonstrated experience managing multi-million-dollar programs with multiple workstreams and cross-functional teams.
- Experience leading business process improvement initiatives utilizing Lean, Six Sigma, Business Process Management (BPM), or similar methodologies.
- Experience managing third-party vendors, system integrators, and consulting organizations.

Desired Certifications
- Project Management Professional (PMP)
- Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt
- Prosci Change Management Certification

Candidates with understanding of the following will be preferre d:
This role is ideal for a transformational leader who can bridge business operations, utility processes, and enterprise technology implementation to deliver sustainable organizational outcomes. Candidates with understanding of the following will be preferred:
- Customer service operations
- Billing and collections
- Meter-to-cash processes
- Work and asset management
- Regulatory compliance requirements
- Field service operations
- Emergency response processes
- Utility customer experience
Additional Information
Sia invests in total rewards that support how our people work, live, and grow.
Compensation
- Base Salary: $150,000–$170,000. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by applicable law.
- Annual Performance Bonus

Benefits
- Medical, dental, and vision; company-paid life and AD&D; voluntary supplemental insurance and EAP
- 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting; HSA and FSA options
- College savings and student loan repayment programs
- Paid parental leave; generous PTO, nine company holidays, and one floating holiday
- Cell phone stipend; well-being and professional development programs

Benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

At Sia, we believe in fostering a  diverse, equitable and inclusive  culture where our employees and partners are valued and thrive in a sense of  belonging . We are committed to recruiting and developing a diverse network of employees and investing in their growth by providing unique opportunities for professional and cultural immersion. jobs.title: Consultant –  Agent Builder / IA agentique
jobs.description:
Pour accompagner le déploiement de l'IA agentique chez ses clients et en interne, Sia recrute un(e) consultant(e) Agent Builder .
L'Agent Builder conçoit, industrialise et fait adopter des agents IA : assistants métiers, automatisations multi-étapes, copilotes intégrés aux outils du client. Le poste est à la fois technique et fonctionnel : vous traduisez un besoin métier en agent qui fonctionne réellement en production , et vous en démontrez la valeur.
Au sein d'une équipe de consultants expérimentés et en plein essor, vous accompagnerez nos clients notamment sur les missions suivantes :
- Échanger avec les différentes parties prenantes pour identifier, qualifier et prioriser les cas d'usage agentiques à fort impact
- Concevoir l'architecture d'un agent : découpage des tâches, choix du modèle, outils et connecteurs, mémoire, garde-fous et points de contrôle humain
- Construire et itérer sur des agents avec les plateformes du marché (Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude, Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI, LangGraph, n8n, Google AgentSpace, …etc.)
- Réaliser le prompt engineering et le context engineering : instructions système, découpage des skills, intégration des sources de connaissance (RAG, SharePoint, bases documentaires)
- Intégrer les agents au SI du client via API, MCP et connecteurs métiers (Microsoft 365, CRM, ERP, ITSM)
- Évaluer et fiabiliser : jeux de tests, mesure de la qualité des réponses, détection des régressions, suivi des coûts et de la latence
- Sécuriser le déploiement : gestion des droits et des données, traçabilité, conformité au cadre réglementaire applicable et aux politiques IA du client
- Accompagner l'adoption : formation des utilisateurs, documentation, transfert de compétences aux équipes du client

Dans le cadre des activités internes du cabinet, votre participation s'articule autour des axes suivants :
- Contribuer à la construction de nos offres et de nos accélérateurs sur l'IA agentique
- Capitaliser sur les agents, skills et briques réutilisables développés en mission
- Participer aux réponses aux appels d'offres et aux démonstrations client
- Animer la communauté interne : veille technologique, partages de bonnes pratiques, montée en compétence des équipes
Diplômé(e) d’un  niveau Bac+5 , vous disposez d'une expérience impérative sur des outils agentiques . Les candidatures sans pratique effective d'une plateforme de création d'agents ne pourront pas être retenues.
- Vous avez déjà conçu et mis en production au moins un agent IA avec un outil du marché : Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude / Claude Agent SDK, Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI Assistants ou AgentKit, Google Agentspace, LangChain / LangGraph, CrewAI, n8n ou équivalent
- De 2 à 6 ans d'expérience en conseil, data, développement logiciel ou transformation digitale
- Diplôme d'une grande école d'ingénieurs, de commerce ou d'université, avec une composante technique ou data
- Maîtrise du prompt engineering et compréhension concrète des limites des LLM : hallucinations, fenêtre de contexte, coût, latence
- Maîtrise de Python et pratique des API REST ; la connaissance du protocole MCP est un plus significatif
- Compréhension des architectures RAG : découpage, embeddings, bases vectorielles, stratégies de récupération
- Expérience de l'écosystème Microsoft 365 et Power Platform, ou d'une plateforme cloud (Azure, GCP, AWS)
Pour plus d'information sur notre practice Data Science, consultez notre showroom de solutions IA : https://www.heka.ai/fr
Rejoindre Sia, c’est :
- Travailler sur des missions à fort impact dans des secteurs d’activités variés (énergie, luxe, transport, finance…),
- Développer ses compétences grâce à un large choix de formations et certifications en data
- Évoluer dans un environnement stimulant, entre projets R&D à forte valeur ajoutée et partages d'expertise via des publications : https://sia-ai.medium.com/
- S’impliquer dans des initiatives transverses sur des thématiques actuelles comme l’IA générative ou la transition écologique

jobs.title: Manager – Sustainability Strategy, Transformation & Operationalization
jobs.description:
Dans le cadre de ses activités Risk, Steering & Sustainability, Sia accompagne les principales institutions financières françaises et européennes dans la définition, la transformation et l’opérationnalisation de leurs stratégies Sustainability. Nos équipes interviennent de la stratégie ESG et des plans de transition/adaptation jusqu’à leur déclinaison dans les modèles d’activité, les offres, les processus métiers, la gouvernance, la data, le reporting et les dispositifs de pilotage de la performance.
En tant que Manager, vous intervenez notamment sur les problématiques suivantes :
- Stratégie Sustainability & ESG : définition et déclinaison des stratégies ESG, analyses de matérialité, identification des priorités, ambitions et objectifs, construction des feuilles de route et articulation avec la stratégie, le business plan et les dispositifs de pilotage de l’institution.

- Transition Planning & Net Zero : conception et mise en œuvre de plans de transition, définition de trajectoires de décarbonation sectorielles et de portefeuille, objectifs intermédiaires et KPIs, identification des leviers d’action et intégration dans les plans stratégiques, commerciaux et financiers.

- Adaptation & résilience climatique : diagnostic des vulnérabilités physiques des activités, actifs, portefeuilles et chaînes de valeur, définition de plans d’adaptation, priorisation des mesures de résilience et analyses coûts/bénéfices. Intégration dans les stratégies, politiques de financement et d’investissement, dispositifs de prévention et plans de continuité.

- Transformation des modèles d’activité & Sustainable Finance : intégration des enjeux ESG dans les stratégies commerciales, modèles d’activité, offres de produits et services et politiques de financement ou d’investissement. Identification des opportunités liées à la transition et développement de nouvelles propositions de valeur durables pour les clients et les métiers.

- Intégration ESG dans les processus métiers : déclinaison des critères ESG dans les processus d’octroi, pricing, conseil, investissement, due diligence, suivi des contreparties et gestion des portefeuilles, avec définition de politiques, critères d’éligibilité, exclusions, seuils, plans d’engagement et dispositifs de remédiation.

- Gouvernance & Target Operating Model ESG : définition des modèles de gouvernance, rôles et responsabilités, instances de décision et interactions entre Sustainability, Risk, Finance, Data et métiers ; conception des Target Operating Models, processus cibles et feuilles de route de transformation organisationnelle.

- Réglementation & reporting Sustainability : analyse et mise en œuvre des exigences de finance durable et de transparence – CSRD/ESRS, Taxonomie européenne, SFDR, Pilier 3 ESG et autres cadres applicables – depuis l’analyse des exigences et du gap jusqu’à la production, aux contrôles et à l’industrialisation du reporting.

- ESG Data & outils de pilotage : définition des modèles de données, dictionnaires, taxonomies et indicateurs ESG, sourcing et qualification des données internes et externes, gouvernance et qualité, règles de calcul et industrialisation des chaînes de données. Développement de KPIs, dashboards et dispositifs de suivi permettant de piloter engagements, trajectoires et performance ESG.

- Nature, biodiversité & enjeux sociaux : intégration des dépendances, impacts, risques et opportunités liés à la nature ainsi que des enjeux sociaux et sociétaux dans les stratégies et dispositifs ESG. Réalisation d’analyses de matérialité, définition de politiques, indicateurs et plans d’action couvrant notamment biodiversité, eau, pollution, ressources naturelles et impacts sociaux.

jobs.title: Consultant Senior – ESG Risk Modelling & Climate/Nature Stress Testing
jobs.description:
Dans le cadre de ses activités Risk, Steering & Sustainability, Sia accompagne les principales institutions financières françaises et européennes dans la modélisation, la quantification et l’intégration des risques climatiques, environnementaux et liés à la nature. Nos équipes interviennent sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur : modélisation des risques physiques, de transition et de nature, analyse de scénarios et stress testing, data et géospatial, intégration dans les modèles de risque et les processus métiers, ainsi que dans les dispositifs de pilotage Risk & Finance, l’ICAAP, le RAF, le capital planning et les trajectoires budgétaires et financières.
En tant que Consultant(e) Senior, vous intervenez notamment sur les problématiques suivantes :
- Modélisation des risques physiques climatiques : développement de méthodologies quantitatives pour évaluer l’exposition et la vulnérabilité des actifs, contreparties et portefeuilles aux aléas climatiques aigus et chroniques. Les travaux couvrent données climatiques et géospatiales, géolocalisation, indicateurs d’intensité et de fréquence, fonctions de vulnérabilité et de dommage, puis traduction en pertes économiques et financières. Les analyses sont déclinées par aléa – inondation, sécheresse, submersion, canicule, incendie, tempête, stress hydrique – et intégrées aux paramètres de risque, collatéraux, stress tests et pilotage des portefeuilles.

- Modélisation des risques de transition climatique : conception de modèles quantifiant l’impact des trajectoires de transition sur les secteurs, contreparties et portefeuilles. Les travaux intègrent les effets du prix du carbone et des évolutions réglementaires, technologiques, énergétiques et de marché sur les revenus, coûts, marges, CAPEX et valorisations. Ces impacts sont traduits en trajectoires financières, paramètres de risque – PD, LGD, ratings – et pertes attendues pour alimenter stress tests, ICAAP, RAF, politiques de crédit et stratégies de portefeuille.

- Modélisation des risques liés à la nature et à la biodiversité : développement de méthodologies quantitatives pour mesurer dépendances, impacts et pressions sur la nature au niveau des activités, actifs et portefeuilles. Les travaux combinent analyses sectorielles et géospatiales, services écosystémiques, pressions environnementales, zones sensibles et scénarios de dégradation des écosystèmes. Les impacts sont traduits en effets économiques et financiers, paramètres de risque et pertes potentielles pour alimenter stress tests nature, ICAAP, RAF et processus de crédit et d’investissement.

- Scenario Analysis & Climate Stress Testing : conception et adaptation de scénarios climatiques prospectifs à partir des référentiels NGFS/IPCC, définition des horizons, variables et facteurs de risque, déclinaison sectorielle et géographique et calibration de chocs physiques, énergétiques, réglementaires et macrofinanciers. Développement de modèles satellites et traduction des trajectoires climatiques en impacts sur revenus, coûts, valorisations, paramètres de risque, coût du risque, provisions, RWA, P&L, capital et liquidité.

- Scenario Analysis & Nature Stress Testing : construction de scénarios de dégradation des écosystèmes, raréfaction des ressources ou évolution des politiques environnementales, identification des dépendances aux services écosystémiques – eau, sols, pollinisation, régulation climatique – et des pressions critiques sur la nature. Les travaux combinent analyses sectorielles et géospatiales, chaînes de transmission et modélisation des effets sur l’activité, les coûts, les actifs et la solvabilité des contreparties afin d’identifier les vulnérabilités et concentrations de risque des portefeuilles.

- Intégration dans les modèles et métriques de risque : analyse et quantification de l’impact des facteurs climatiques et environnementaux sur les paramètres de risque – PD, LGD, EAD, ratings, scoring, valorisation des collatéraux, volatilité, valorisation de marché ou pertes opérationnelles – et développement d’approches permettant leur intégration dans les modèles de crédit, de marché, de risque opérationnel, de portefeuille et de stress testing.

- Intégration dans les usages métiers et le pilotage Risk & Finance : déclinaison des indicateurs, scores et facteurs de risque climat/nature dans les processus d’octroi, de pricing, de conseil, de prévention, de revue et de gestion des portefeuilles, ainsi que dans le RAF, l’ICAAP, le capital planning, le budget et les trajectoires financières. Les travaux couvrent la définition de critères d’éligibilité, limites, seuils d’alerte et plans d’action, ainsi que l’intégration dans l’allocation du capital, le pilotage du coût du risque, des RWA, du P&L et de la rentabilité.

- Data & Analytics climat/nature: identification, sélection et combinaison des données nécessaires aux modèles de risques physiques, de transition et de nature : données climatiques et d’aléas, géolocalisation des actifs, émissions et trajectoires carbone, données sectorielles et financières, dépendances aux services écosystémiques, pressions environnementales et zones sensibles. Les travaux couvrent également la définition des proxies et règles d’enrichissement, le croisement spatial et sectoriel des expositions, la construction des variables de risque et l’industrialisation des chaînes de calcul alimentant scores, stress tests et modèles financiers.

- Data Visualisation & outils de pilotage climat/nature : conception de dispositifs de visualisation permettant d’exploiter et restituer les résultats des modèles climat et nature : cartographies interactives et analyses géospatiales sous QGIS/SIG, heatmaps d’exposition et de vulnérabilité, dashboards de risques et de portefeuille sous Power BI/Tableau, visualisation des scénarios et trajectoires de stress, drill-down jusqu’à l’actif ou la contrepartie et développement d’outils d’aide à la décision pour les fonctions Risk, Finance et métiers.
